nodes.summary: Removing `k` copies of the positive part `v` gives a bijection from partitions of `E` containing at least `k` copies of `v` to partitions of `E - k * v`.
nodes.title: Bijection removing $k$ copies of a part from partitions

nodes.summary: The number of integer partitions of `n` is at most `exp (π * sqrt (2 / 3) * sqrt n)`.
nodes.title: Exponential upper bound for the partition function

nodes.summary: The number of integer partitions is monotone in the integer being partitioned.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the partition function

nodes.summary: The number of partitions of `n` is at least `H * exp (pi * sqrt (2 / 3) * sqrt n) / n ^ B` for some `H > 0` and natural `B`, when `n ≥ 1`.
nodes.title: Exponential lower bound for the partition function

nodes.summary: There are constants `B` and `C` such that the base-two logarithm of the number of integer partitions of `n` differs from its leading square-root term by at most a logarithmic lower-order term below and a constant above.
nodes.title: Logarithmic bounds for the partition function

nodes.summary: A recurrence obtained by summing all parts of all partitions of `E`, first by partition and then by part value and multiplicity threshold.
nodes.title: Sum-of-parts recurrence for the partition function

nodes.summary: The number of partitions of `n` is at least `(n + 1) / 2`.
nodes.title: Linear lower bound for the partition function

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
